scenes.headline: How Kimi K3 spends 2.8 trillion parameters
scenes.sub: Delta attention, residuals across depth, and 16 of 896 experts.
scenes.say: Hi, I'm Cider! Kimi K3 is the largest open model yet. What's interesting is how its parameters are spent.

scenes.label: What's new
scenes.text: K3 reworks how information flows along the sequence, up through the layers and out to the experts, so each FLOP buys more.
scenes.say: K3 reworks how information flows three ways: along the sequence, up the layers, and out to its experts. Each makes compute go further.

scenes.title: One K3 layer, bottom to top

steps.say: A token climbs ninety-three layers: attention, then a mixture of experts, each time.

steps.note: 3 KDA layers for every Gated MLA
steps.say: Three in four attention layers are Kimi Delta Attention. It keeps a fixed-size memory: each token erases a little and writes its own key and value.
Every fourth is Gated MLA, full attention for exact recall. None use positional encoding; the delta layers carry order through their decay.
Then the experts: sixteen of eight hundred and ninety-six, plus two shared, working in a latent space half the model's width.
Attention Residuals let each layer pick from earlier blocks and the embedding, instead of piling everything into one running sum.
The router picks one more expert than it needs. That extra score is the cutoff a rival expert had to beat.
Each expert's margins, its score minus the cutoff, are binned locally, and one all-reduce sums the bins across the cluster.
Its next bias is read straight off a quantile, which hands every expert its target load. No auxiliary loss, no knob.

scenes.label: fewer FLOPs than K2 at equal validation loss, on fitted scaling curves
scenes.say: Together, K3 matches K2's validation loss with about two and a half times fewer FLOPs.

scenes.text: Parameter count is a spec-sheet figure. More capability per FLOP is the engineering result.
scenes.say: Parameter count is a spec-sheet figure. More capability per FLOP is the engineering result.

recap: Delta attention: a fixed-size memory for 1M tokens
Attention Residuals: each layer picks earlier blocks
16 of 896 experts, balanced by a quantile
scenes.say: To recap: a memory that never grows, residuals that choose, and experts balanced by a quantile.
